<svg viewBox="0 0 900 400" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xmlns:c2pa="http://c2pa.org/manifest"><metadata><c2pa:manifest></c2pa:manifest></metadata>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="spaceBg" cx="50%" cy="45%" r="75%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#141225"/>
      <stop offset="55%" stop-color="#0a0815"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#020103"/>
    </radialGradient>

    <filter id="glow" x="-100%" y="-100%" width="300%" height="300%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="9" result="blur"/>
      <feMerge>
        <feMergeNode in="blur"/>
        <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
      </feMerge>
    </filter>

    <symbol id="gem" viewBox="-20 -30 40 60">
      <polygon points="0,-30 15,-12 10,30 -10,30 -15,-12" fill="currentColor" opacity="0.85"/>
      <polygon points="0,-30 15,-12 0,-2 -15,-12" fill="currentColor" opacity="1"/>
      <polygon points="-15,-12 0,-2 -10,30" fill="currentColor" opacity="0.55"/>
      <polygon points="15,-12 0,-2 10,30" fill="currentColor" opacity="0.7"/>
      <polygon points="0,-30 15,-12 0,-2" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.35"/>
    </symbol>
  </defs>

  <rect width="900" height="400" fill="url(#spaceBg)"/>

  <!-- starfield -->
  <g fill="#ffffff">
    <circle cx="40" cy="40" r="1.1" opacity="0.6"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.2;0.9;0.2" dur="3s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></circle>
    <circle cx="130" cy="90" r="1" opacity="0.4"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.6;0.1;0.6" dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></circle>
    <circle cx="220" cy="40" r="1.3" opacity="0.5"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.2;0.8;0.2" dur="2.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></circle>
    <circle cx="330" cy="70" r="1" opacity="0.4"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.5;0.1;0.5" dur="3.4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></circle>
    <circle cx="500" cy="35" r="1.2" opacity="0.5"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.2;0.9;0.2" dur="3.8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></circle>
    <circle cx="620" cy="80" r="1" opacity="0.4"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.6;0.15;0.6" dur="2.9s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></circle>
    <circle cx="700" cy="30" r="1.1" opacity="0.5"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.2;0.85;0.2" dur="3.1s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></circle>
    <circle cx="820" cy="70" r="1" opacity="0.4"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.5;0.1;0.5" dur="4.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></circle>
    <circle cx="60" cy="330" r="1.2" opacity="0.5"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.2;0.8;0.2" dur="3.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></circle>
    <circle cx="180" cy="370" r="1" opacity="0.4"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.6;0.1;0.6" dur="2.7s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></circle>
    <circle cx="380" cy="360" r="1.1" opacity="0.5"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.2;0.9;0.2" dur="3.3s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></circle>
    <circle cx="540" cy="380" r="1" opacity="0.4"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.5;0.1;0.5" dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></circle>
    <circle cx="680" cy="350" r="1.2" opacity="0.5"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.2;0.85;0.2" dur="2.8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></circle>
    <circle cx="850" cy="330" r="1" opacity="0.4"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.6;0.15;0.6" dur="3.5s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></circle>
    <circle cx="450" cy="380" r="1.3" opacity="0.5"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.2;0.9;0.2" dur="3s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></circle>
  </g>

  <!-- faint nebula wisps -->
  <ellipse cx="230" cy="200" rx="180" ry="60" fill="#3b82f6" opacity="0.05"/>
  <ellipse cx="650" cy="230" rx="200" ry="70" fill="#f97316" opacity="0.05"/>
  <ellipse cx="450" cy="120" rx="220" ry="50" fill="#10b981" opacity="0.05"/>

  <!-- SPACE STONE (blue) -->
  <g transform="translate(120,150)">
    <circle r="42" fill="#3b82f6" opacity="0.35" filter="url(#glow)"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.25;0.5;0.25" dur="3.4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></circle>
    <g><animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0,0; 0,-9; 0,0" dur="5s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <g style="color:#3b82f6"><use href="#gem" width="34" height="50" x="-17" y="-25"/></g>
    </g>
    <text x="0" y="60" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Consolas, monospace" font-size="10" fill="#7fb3ff" letter-spacing="2">SPACE</text>
  </g>

  <!-- MIND STONE (yellow) -->
  <g transform="translate(255,275)">
    <circle r="40" fill="#fbbf24" opacity="0.35" filter="url(#glow)"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.25;0.5;0.25" dur="2.9s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></circle>
    <g><animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0,0; 0,-7; 0,0" dur="4.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <g style="color:#fbbf24"><use href="#gem" width="32" height="48" x="-16" y="-24"/></g>
    </g>
    <text x="0" y="58" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Consolas, monospace" font-size="10" fill="#ffd873" letter-spacing="2">MIND</text>
  </g>

  <!-- REALITY STONE (red) -->
  <g transform="translate(420,95)">
    <circle r="40" fill="#ef4444" opacity="0.35" filter="url(#glow)"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.25;0.5;0.25" dur="3.7s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></circle>
    <g><animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0,0; 0,-8; 0,0" dur="4.7s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <g style="color:#ef4444"><use href="#gem" width="32" height="48" x="-16" y="-24"/></g>
    </g>
    <text x="0" y="58" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Consolas, monospace" font-size="10" fill="#ff9d9d" letter-spacing="2">REALITY</text>
  </g>

  <!-- POWER STONE (purple) -->
  <g transform="translate(600,265)">
    <circle r="40" fill="#8b5cf6" opacity="0.35" filter="url(#glow)"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.25;0.5;0.25" dur="3.1s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></circle>
    <g><animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0,0; 0,-9; 0,0" dur="4.5s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <g style="color:#8b5cf6"><use href="#gem" width="32" height="48" x="-16" y="-24"/></g>
    </g>
    <text x="0" y="58" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Consolas, monospace" font-size="10" fill="#c9a9ff" letter-spacing="2">POWER</text>
  </g>

  <!-- SOUL STONE (orange) -->
  <g transform="translate(760,170)">
    <circle r="40" fill="#f97316" opacity="0.35" filter="url(#glow)"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.25;0.5;0.25" dur="3.9s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></circle>
    <g><animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0,0; 0,-7; 0,0" dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <g style="color:#f97316"><use href="#gem" width="32" height="48" x="-16" y="-24"/></g>
    </g>
    <text x="0" y="58" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Consolas, monospace" font-size="10" fill="#ffc08a" letter-spacing="2">SOUL</text>
  </g>

  <!-- TIME STONE (green, centered + emphasized) -->
  <g transform="translate(460,210)">
    <circle r="60" fill="#10b981" opacity="0.4" filter="url(#glow)"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.3;0.65;0.3" dur="2.4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></circle>
    <g>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0" to="360" dur="24s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <circle r="55" fill="none" stroke="#34d399" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="3 9" opacity="0.6"/>
    </g>
    <g><animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0,0; 0,-10; 0,0" dur="3.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <g style="color:#10b981"><use href="#gem" width="46" height="68" x="-23" y="-34"/></g>
    </g>
    <text x="0" y="80" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Consolas, monospace" font-size="12" fill="#6ee7b7" font-weight="bold" letter-spacing="3">TIME</text>
  </g>

  <text x="450" y="30" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Consolas, monospace" font-size="13" fill="#8a8fa3" letter-spacing="4">SIX STONES · ONE MULTIVERSE · ALL WATCHING THIS REPO</text>
</svg>
